descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在布拉格做的纸菜单，蛋片和火腿都有稳稳的位置。
descriptions.en: My Prague paper menu gives the egg and ham secure places on their bread.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 吃过牛肉与团子后做的菜单，酱汁只留在纸盘里。
descriptions.en: My menu after beef and dumplings keeps all the sauce inside its paper plate.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我在莱特纳看桥后剪的小纸手，拇指折起来就少数一枚包扣。
descriptions.en: My little paper hand from Letná folds its thumb to keep a mailbag buckle out of the bridge count.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 离开交通展厅后做的小窗纸卡，只画了自己的看展角度。
descriptions.en: A paper window made after the transport hall visit, recording my own viewing angle.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在布拉格自制的折纸，两只纸脚旁边绕着一条纸绳。
descriptions.en: My homemade Prague fold puts a paper rope beside two stationary paper feet.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我做的双层拉页，把看桥时前后遮挡的样子留在纸上，不是实测图。
descriptions.en: My two-layer pullout keeps the overlapping view of the bridges on paper; it is not a measured map.
